summary: Survey360 product page fully tested. All 7 tabs work correctly with URL query params. Mobile navigation with hamburger menu works. Stripe checkout integration functions properly. Design is clean and professional.
passed_tests: Desktop Tests (11/11 passed):
- Survey360 page loads at /solutions/survey360
- DataVision main navigation visible at top
- Survey360 sticky navigation with 7 tabs (Overview, Features, How It Works, Use Cases, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ)
- Overview tab shows hero section with CTAs (Start Free Trial, Watch Demo)
- Features tab shows detailed feature breakdown with 6 features + 10 question types
- Tab navigation updates URL query param (?tab=features, ?tab=pricing, etc.)
- Pricing tab shows 3 plans: Monthly $99, Annual $990, Enterprise Custom
- Pricing 'Get Started' button initiates Stripe checkout (redirects to checkout.stripe.com)
- FAQ tab shows accordion-style questions (expand/collapse working)
- Direct URL navigation with query params works (?tab=use-cases loads Use Cases content)
- Testimonials and How It Works tabs display correct content
Mobile Tests (4/4 passed):
- Survey360 loads correctly on mobile viewport (390x844)
- Mobile menu (chevron dropdown) shows all 7 tabs
- Mobile tab navigation works (clicking tabs changes content and URL)
- Sticky navigation works after scrolling on mobile
Stripe Integration (2/2 passed):
- Buy buttons have correct data-testid (buy-survey360_monthly-btn, buy-survey360_annual-btn)
- Clicking Get Started calls /api/payments/checkout and receives Stripe checkout URL
